verdict.rationale: Grok Build supports running parallel attempts. `/fork` branches a session into a peer that starts from a copy of the conversation. Worktree sessions run in isolated repo copies so parallel agents don't overwrite each other. A dashboard shows every session's status. However, comparing results across attempts and picking a winner is only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: a documented side-by-side diff or comparison of attempt outputs, a select/merge-winner workflow (e.g. best-of-N), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the parallel-attempt workflow.
